title: Indoor spin warm-up and spin-up
instructions: Mount your road bike on the indoor trainer. Pedal at an easy, conversational pace for 5 minutes, focusing on smooth circles.

title: Steady aerobic spin
instructions: Maintain a steady, conversational cadence for 20 minutes on the trainer. Keep your upper body relaxed and core engaged.

title: Cooldown spin and stretch
instructions: Drop resistance to the lowest setting and pedal easily for 5 minutes, followed by a quick standing quad and calf stretch off the bike.

title: Trainer warm-up and build
instructions: Spend 5 minutes spinning easy on the trainer to warm up your legs and get comfortable.

title: Controlled hill simulation intervals
instructions: Do 4 sets of 3-minute moderately hard efforts (simulating a hill climb) at a lower cadence of 70-80 RPM, with 2 minutes of easy spinning recovery between each set.

title: Easy spin down
instructions: Pedal easily with no added resistance for 5 minutes to flush out the legs.

title: Easy warm-up spin
instructions: Pedal lightly on the indoor trainer for 5 minutes to wake up the legs.

title: High-cadence leg speed drills
instructions: Alternate between 2 minutes of fast, light-resistance spinning (high RPM) and 2 minutes of normal cadence, repeating this cycle 4 times for a total of 16 minutes.

title: Steady aerobic finish
instructions: Ride at your normal baseline conversational pace for 9 minutes to round out the 30-minute session.

title: Easy conversational spin
instructions: Spin on the trainer at an effortless, conversational pace for 15 minutes.

title: Short accelerations
instructions: Perform three 30-second light gear increases to feel some tension, followed by 90 seconds of easy spinning after each.

title: Spin down and gear check
instructions: Spin easy for 9 minutes while checking your bike fit, tire pressure, and ensuring your water bottle is ready for tomorrow.

title: Pre-test warm-up
instructions: Pedal easily for 5 minutes to prepare your muscles for the test ride.

title: Weekly test: Complete a single weekend ride of at least the target distance.. Pass if: Completed 30 km without stopping to walk any hills.
instructions: Ride 30 km continuously (outdoors or on your trainer) at a steady, sustainable, conversational pace without stopping to walk or quit on any incline.

title: Test review and cool-down
instructions: Spin easy for 5 minutes, record your distance and time, and verify if you achieved the target without walking.

title: Deadlift Volume Working Sets
instructions: Begin with 5 minutes of dynamic mobility including cat-cows and bodyweight good mornings. Perform 2 gradual ramp-up warm-up sets, then complete 5 working sets of 5 reps at 1.35x bodyweight with 3 minutes rest between sets. Maintain neutral spine alignment, brace your core before every pull, and log your exact weight, reps, and perceived exertion after the final set.

title: Posterior Chain Mobility
instructions: Spend 5 minutes performing static hamstrings and hip flexor stretches to maintain lower body mobility.

title: Core Bracing and Moderate Pulls
instructions: Start with 5 minutes of core activation including planks and bird-dogs. Follow with moderate-load deadlift technique sets at 1.1x bodyweight for 3 sets of 5 reps, focusing on maximal core tension and neutral spine. Log your session details upon completion.

title: Thoracic Spine Mobility
instructions: Perform 10 minutes of foam rolling and thoracic extension movements to keep the upper back supple.

title: Key Session Deadlift Volume
instructions: Perform 5 minutes of dynamic leg swings and light deadlifts with an empty bar. Execute gradual ramp-up sets, then complete 5 working sets of 3 reps at 1.35x bodyweight, taking 3 full minutes of rest between sets. Record your working weight, reps, and RPE at the end.

title: Hip and Glute Mobility
instructions: Spend 5 minutes stretching the glutes and hips to prevent post-workout tightness.

title: Prime and Prep Deadlifts
instructions: Perform 5 minutes of dynamic warm-ups (hip circles, bodyweight squats). Complete 3 light ramp-up sets, followed by 3 working singles at 1.2x bodyweight to groove the pattern without fatigue. Log your pre-test readiness and perceived bar speed.

title: Lower Body Mobility
instructions: Do 10 minutes of light stretching focusing on hamstrings and calves to ensure full range of motion for tomorrow.

title: Test Warm-Up
instructions: Perform 5 minutes of dynamic mobility and gradual ramp-up sets to prepare for the test weight.

title: Weekly test: Record your heaviest working set from the side angle.. Pass if: Complete the required weight with clean form and no rounding of the lower back.
instructions: Set up a camera from the side angle to record. Load the bar to 1.35x your bodyweight, brace your core, maintain a neutral spine, and execute a clean single working set. Stop immediately if any sharp pain occurs.

title: Result Comparison
instructions: Review the side-angle video, confirm form compliance, and compare the result against the week 1 target ratio.

title: Review school vocabulary flashcards
instructions: Spend the first 5 minutes reviewing old school vocabulary cards for greetings, numbers, and basic nouns. Say every German word aloud before looking at the definition.

title: Shadow audio prompts for self-introduction
instructions: Listen to a basic German audio lesson and repeat every phrase aloud immediately during the pauses, focusing on continuous flow rather than perfect grammar.

title: Record a 30-second speaking drill
instructions: Press record on your phone and speak for 30 continuous seconds about your name, origin, and profession in German without switching to English.

title: Warm up with school vocabulary retrieval
instructions: Quickly review past verbs related to daily actions, recalling meanings before checking notes.

title: Practice daily routine sentences aloud
instructions: Build and speak aloud simple sentences describing what you do in the morning, afternoon, and evening using basic school vocabulary.

title: Simulate a 1-minute uninterrupted monologue
instructions: Set a timer for 1 minute and speak continuously about your morning routine in German without pausing for English translations.

title: Review hobby and activity vocabulary
instructions: Go through your vocabulary blocks for hobbies, sports, and free-time activities, speaking each item aloud.

title: Shadow German audio about leisure time
instructions: Listen to a short audio track discussing leisure activities and shadow the speaker aloud.

title: Record a 45-second hobby monologue
instructions: Record a voice note describing what you like to do on weekends in German.

title: Review all core school vocabulary blocks
instructions: Quickly cycle through all vocabulary blocks from this week, actively recalling definitions before checking references.

title: Draft and rehearse daily routine talking points
instructions: Practice speaking aloud about your daily schedule, hobbies, and personal background, linking them together into a coherent flow.

title: Test run of the 1-minute monologue
instructions: Perform a practice run of tomorrow's test: record a full 60 seconds of continuous German speech about your daily routine.

title: Warm up with a quick vocabulary review
instructions: Spend 3 minutes reviewing key routine verbs and nouns to prime your brain for German recall.

title: Weekly test: Record a video of yourself speaking German continuously about your daily routine for 1 minute.
instructions: Record a video of yourself speaking German continuously about your daily routine for 1 minute. Pass if: Spoke for at least 60 seconds without switching to English.

title: Compare result with the target
instructions: Review your video recording to verify that you spoke for 60 seconds straight without English, and log your result against the 1-minute target.

title: Watch Professor Messer Security+ Video on CIA Triad
instructions: Begin with a 2-minute mental review of basic IT concepts. Then watch the first video module covering Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability, taking bullet-point notes.

title: Review Notes and Identify Gaps
instructions: Spend the remaining time reviewing your notes and highlighting terms you find unfamiliar or difficult to remember.

title: Watch Video on Security Control Types
instructions: Start with a 2-minute review of yesterday's CIA triad notes. Watch the Professor Messer video covering preventive, detective, corrective, and deterrent controls, taking active notes.

title: Domain 1 Practice Questions
instructions: Complete 5 practice questions related to security controls and the CIA triad. Review every incorrect answer immediately.

title: Watch AAA Framework Video
instructions: Do a 2-minute mental recap of security controls. Watch the Professor Messer video detailing Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting concepts, noting key terms like MFA and SSO.

title: AAA Concept Flashcard Review
instructions: Create and review quick mental or physical flashcards for terms introduced in today's video.

title: Watch Threat Intelligence Video
instructions: Spend 2 minutes reviewing AAA concepts. Watch the Professor Messer video covering threat actors (APT, insiders, script kiddies) and threat intelligence sources, taking structured notes.

title: Domain 1 Comprehensive Practice
instructions: Complete 10 practice questions covering the entire week's worth of Domain 1 topics. Immediately review every missed question.

title: Pre-Test Warm-Up
instructions: Spend 3 minutes reviewing your high-level notes on the CIA triad and security controls to prime your memory.

title: Weekly test: 20-Question Domain 1 Practice Quiz
instructions: Take a timed 20-question practice quiz covering Domain 1 without using notes or pauses. Score yourself immediately afterwards.

title: Post-Test Evaluation
instructions: Compare your test score against the 70% target. Document any missed questions in your review log for next week.

title: Draft podcast title and tagline
instructions: Spend the first 2 minutes brainstorming ideas. Then write down 3 potential podcast titles and a one-sentence tagline that explains who the show is for.

title: Outline episode structure
instructions: Write out a simple 4-part structure for your episodes: intro, guest intro, main question, and outro.

title: Choose and configure podcast host
instructions: Spend 2 minutes reviewing basic hosting options. Then select a podcast hosting platform, create your account, and enter your show title, description, and newly created tagline.

title: Design basic podcast artwork
instructions: Use a simple graphic design tool to create a square podcast cover image featuring your podcast title in clear, readable text.

title: Brainstorm potential guest names
instructions: Open a spreadsheet or document and list the names of 5 people who have expertise in your topic or would make great interview subjects.

title: Draft outreach message template
instructions: Write a short, friendly outreach message template that introduces your show, explains why they are a great fit, and asks for a short interview.

title: Personalize and send outreach messages
instructions: Spend 2 minutes reviewing your guest list. Then take your outreach template, customize it with specific details for 3 different people on your list, and send the messages.

title: Log outreach tracking status
instructions: Update your guest tracking document to mark those 3 people as contacted along with today's date.

title: Warm-up: Open tracking and hosting dashboards
instructions: Open your podcast hosting dashboard tab and your guest outreach tracking document in your browser.

title: Weekly test: Count messages and verify hosting
instructions: Count the number of outreach messages sent and verify hosting account setup.. Pass if: Podcast hosting is configured and at least 3 outreach messages have been sent.

title: Log test results
instructions: Write down a one-sentence summary of your test result to close out the week.

title: Complete 5 life and death problems
instructions: Set up a physical or online board with 5 basic tsumego problems. Before touching any stone or clicking, count to 5 slowly and trace the opponent's strongest reply in your head. Do not rush.

title: Study basic corner enclosure theory
instructions: Warm up by reviewing standard 3-4 point corner enclosures for 3 minutes. Then, spend 12 minutes studying Joseki variations to understand standard responses.

title: Solve 5 tsumego problems
instructions: Warm up your tactical vision by solving 5 easy-to-medium life and death problems, applying the 5-second rule before every move.

title: Play and review one ranked game
instructions: Start with a 3-minute warm-up of reviewing basic opening principles. Then play one online ranked game. Enforce the 5-second rule on every single move without exception. Immediately after the game, spend at least 10 minutes reviewing it by yourself using your own analysis without AI assistance.

title: Solve 5 tsumego problems
instructions: Complete 5 life and death problems, strictly timing your 5-second pre-move pause.

title: Study basic endgame point counting
instructions: Warm up for 3 minutes by checking standard endgame shapes. Then spend 12 minutes studying basic point values of hane and connect moves.

title: Solve 5 tsumego problems
instructions: Complete 5 tactics puzzles while consciously slowing down your impulse to play instantly.

title: Play and review your second ranked game
instructions: Spend 3 minutes warming up on opening principles. Play one online ranked game, strictly obeying the 5-second rule on every move. Immediately after, review the game by yourself for 10 minutes before checking any AI.

title: Weekly test warm-up
instructions: Open your game history and logs from the week to prepare for the audit.

title: Weekly test: Count reviewed games
instructions: Count the number of ranked games reviewed this week. Pass if at least 3 games are fully reviewed.

title: Result comparison
instructions: Compare your weekly test result with the target of 3 fully reviewed games and note your progress.
